channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Ensure No Eligible Voter Is Left Out During SIR: Akbaruddin Owaisi Advises Telangana Government
item.description: AIMIM leader Akbaruddin Owaisi urges the Telangana government to ensure no eligible voter is excluded during the Special Intensive Revision of voter lists.

item.title: Telangana Reopens Gruha Jyothi and Mahalakshmi Schemes: Who Is Eligible and What Documents Are Required?
item.description: Telangana government reopens applications for Gruha Jyothi and Mahalakshmi schemes, allowing eligible beneficiaries and new ration card holders to apply again.

item.title: Hyderabad Metro Issues Kite-Flying Warning Ahead of Sankranti, Imposes Restrictions Near Corridors
item.description: Hyderabad Metro Rail warns of kite-flying risks during Sankranti, bans kites near stations and corridors to prevent power disruptions and ensure commuter safety.

item.title: Kalvakuntla Kavitha’s Resignation as MLC Accepted, Telangana Legislative Council Declares Vacancy
item.description: Kalvakuntla Kavitha resigns as MLC from Nizamabad Local Authorities’ Constituency; Telangana Legislative Council issues official notification declaring the seat vacant.

item.title: Tamil Nadu to operate 10,245 special buses for Pongal festival from Jan 9-14
item.description: Ahead of the Pongal festival, Tamil Nadu Transport Minister S.S. Sivasankar announced an extensive travel arrangement across the state, with thousands of additional buses being operated to ensure smooth and hassle-free movement of passengers during the festive season.

item.title: FIR filed after stone-pelting during demolition drive near Old Delhi Mosque, 10 detained
item.description: According to officials of the Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD), the drive was conducted to clear unauthorised structures from land adjoining the mosque and nearby areas, in compliance with directions issued by the Delhi High Court on November 12, 2025.

item.title: UP CEO explains how voters can check names in draft electoral roll
item.description: The Chief Electoral Officer of Uttar Pradesh on Wednesday shared the procedure for checking whether a person's name has been included in the draft voter list published on January 6.

item.title: NHAI sets two Guinness World Records in construction of Bengaluru-Vijayawada Expressway
item.description: The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has set two Guinness World Records in Andhra Pradesh during the construction of Bengaluru-Kadapa-Vijayawada Expressway.

item.title: Maha civic polls: After tie-up with Congress in Ambernath, BJP joins hands with AIMIM in Akot
item.description: Politics continues to throw up unlikely alliances. After partnering with its traditional rival Congress to wrest control of the Ambernath Municipal Council from the Shiv Sena, the BJP has now stitched together an equally surprising alliance with Asaduddin Owaisi-led AIMIM in Akot to secure control of the Municipal Council there.

item.title: Votes should be sought on development, not by making India look inferior: BJP leader slams Owaisi
item.description: Maharashtra BJP MLA Ram Kadam on Wednesday strongly criticised AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi, saying that his recent statements reflect a loss of perspective and that votes should be sought on logic and development, not by making India look inferior.
